library.name: abcjs
library.description: ABC notation parser and renderer. Only its parser is used, to read ABC source back into the document model; rendering is Verovio's job.

library.name: Verovio
library.description: Music notation engraving library, compiled to WebAssembly. Renders ABC, MusicXML, MEI and compressed MusicXML to SVG, and exports MIDI. The WebAssembly bundle embeds the SMuFL music fonts Verovio ships with - Bravura, Leipzig, Petaluma, Gootville, Leland and VerovioText - each of which is SIL OFL 1.1 licensed and redistributed as part of Verovio itself. Renamed from .mjs to .js because nginx serves an unknown extension as application/octet-stream, which browsers refuse to execute as a module; the file contents are upstream's.

library.name: midi-file
library.description: Standard MIDI File parser. Used by the MIDI import quantiser to read note-on and note-off events, tempo, time signature and key signature out of an uploaded file.
